name: substack.note
description: Substack Growth OS: grade one draft Substack Note for Mike Rodgers (RIG B2B lane) before it is shown to him. Judges whether it stands alone, stops the scroll, carries a specific detail, stays in lane, and avoids pitching. Advisory until calibrated against Mike's labels.

stands_alone.instructions: A reader who has never heard of Mike gets a complete idea from this Note alone, without clicking anything

hook_stops_scroll.instructions: The first line would make a busy operator in a feed stop and read the rest

specific_detail.instructions: The Note carries at least one concrete, lived detail (a number, a named tool or step, a real moment from work or life) instead of an abstraction

pitch_heavy.instructions: The Note is mainly a promotion (subscribe, upgrade, buy, book) rather than giving the reader something first

lane_violation.instructions: The Note mentions or depicts a minor or a child's athletics, or uses the characters Birch, Unit 7 or The Coach

generic_risk.instructions: This Note reads like generic AI-written motivational or marketing content anyone could post

rules.reason: lane violation: minor or Lane A cast on the RIG publication; never auto-draft this (Gate-D, per-post yes only)
generic AI content; replace with a lived detail
mostly a pitch; lead with value, save asks for sprint launches (ss-bestseller)
does not stand alone; Notes are read in the feed, not after a click
first line does not stop the scroll; rewrite it
no concrete detail; add the number, step or moment

notes.created: 2026-09-28 for ss-notes; replaces post.viral as the Note grader. Calibrate with rig-s1gate label as Mike posts or rejects drafts.
